name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates detail lost in upscaling by using depth maps, which directly improves output quality without extra compute—critical for EXCAVA’s 0.5% lift. The trade-off is added complexity in the pipeline, but depth maps are already generated for EXCAVA’s 3D work, so the cost is minimal.

name: Torque
text: Depth maps won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core issue is the u-net’s face pipeline isn’t tested under EXCAVA’s *real* constraints—on real-world video frames with motion blur, occlusions, and lighting shifts. Instead, test SD3.5-Ultr’s new face-refiner node first; if it fails, swap in a dedicated face model like InstantX’s face upscaler—its trade-off is higher compute, but it targets the exact failure mode. Settle it by running both on a 10-second clip with faces and measuring PSNR drop before and after.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add SD3.5-Ultr’s face-refiner node to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. Its dedicated face pipeline handles motion blur, occlusions, and lighting shifts better than depth maps because it’s trained on real-world face data under those exact conditions—directly fixing EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop. The trade-off is extra compute per frame, but the node’s lightweight design keeps the hit minimal while guaranteeing a measurable quality lift.

name: Torque
text: SD3.5-Ultr’s face-refiner node won’t help if EXCAVA’s real bottleneck is motion blur at 30fps—its training data likely assumes sharper inputs. Test InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler first; if it fails, then try the face-refiner node on a controlled 10-frame clip with known occlusions.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Run InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler on a 10-frame EXCAVA clip with worst-case motion blur, then test SD3.5-Ultr’s face-refiner node on the same clip—if depth-aware upscaler fails to recover face fidelity, it owns the pipeline; if face-refiner node recovers more detail, it owns the pipeline.
